name: Derelict Faces [ZIT] - Top-Notch Portraits Maker
description: Have you ever dreamed of creating top-notch portraits? Rich, creative, capturing the viewer's deepest emotions? Try this gem. You'll love it, I promise. There are two revisions, E12 and E09 (checkpoint of Epoch 12 and checkpoint of Epoch 9). Revision E09 is not older than E12; they were both created during the same training cycle. In some cases, E09 may demonstrate greater creativity than E12. V2 are more sharp versions, while V1 are more complex and smooth. You can see the unique generation features that were present only in Epoch 9: angle variability, background variability, and portrait detail variability. After Epoch 9, this variability was corrected, and Epochs 10-11-12 were roughly the same, with only some refinements in detail. These are screenshots from the model training cycle: Choose one of the versions, generate a portrait, and post it to the gallery! Enjoy!
